peaceful.name: Peaceful mobs
peaceful.kid: Animals and helpers that never attack you.

neutral.name: Neutral mobs
neutral.kid: Leave you alone unless you bother them first.

vehicle.name: Rides
vehicle.kid: Boats and minecarts you can ride in.

projectile.name: Flying & thrown things
projectile.kid: Arrows, snowballs, fireballs and other things that fly through the air.

object.name: Placed objects
object.kid: Things you place that count as entities, not blocks.

drop.name: Drops & XP
drop.kid: Items lying on the ground and XP orbs.

special.name: Invisible & special
special.kid: Effects and map-maker tools. Most are invisible.

player.note: Use @a, @p, @r or a player name. On Bedrock you can also use type=player.

allay.note: Give it an item and it collects more of that item for you.

camel.note: Two players can ride it at once.

camel_husk.name: Camel Husk
camel_husk.note: An undead camel that a husk rides in the desert.

copper_golem.note: Sorts items into chests for you.

happy_ghast.note: A friendly ghast you can put a harness on and fly.

nautilus.note: A sea creature you can tame and ride underwater.

strider.note: Walks on lava. Ride it with a saddle.

sulfur_cube.note: Feed it a block and it changes how it bounces and slides.

villager.note: On Bedrock, type=villager finds both old and new villagers.

enderman.note: Gets angry if you look at its face.

goat.note: Rams into you if you stand still too long.

iron_golem.note: Protects villagers. Attacks you only if you hurt it or a villager.

piglin.note: Leaves you alone if you wear gold armor.

pufferfish.note: Puffs up and poisons you if you get close.

bogged.note: A mossy skeleton with poison arrows.

creaking.note: Moves only when you aren't looking at it.

giant.note: A huge zombie that never appears in normal play. Java only, and only with /summon.

illusioner.note: An illager that never appears in normal play. Java only, and only with /summon.

warden.note: Blind, but follows sounds. Super strong!

boat.name: Boat
boat.note: Java has a different ID for each wood, like oak_boat or bamboo_raft. Pick all of them with type=#minecraft:boat. Bedrock has just one: boat.

chest_boat.name: Boat with Chest
chest_boat.note: Java has a different ID for each wood, like oak_chest_boat. Bedrock has just one: chest_boat.

trident.note: A thrown trident. Called thrown_trident on Bedrock.

wither_skull.note: Bedrock has two: wither_skull, and wither_skull_dangerous for the blue one.

fishing_bobber.note: The bobber on a fishing line. Called fishing_hook on Bedrock.

item_frame.note: Java only. On Bedrock, item frames are blocks.

glow_item_frame.note: Java only. On Bedrock, glow item frames are blocks.

leash_knot.note: The knot on a fence when you tie a lead to it.

end_crystal.note: Called ender_crystal on Bedrock. Explodes when hit!

tnt.name: Lit TNT
tnt.note: TNT that has been lit and is about to explode.

falling_block.note: Sand, gravel or anvils while they are falling.

cushion.note: A cushion you can sit on.

mannequin.note: A player-shaped dummy, great for statues. Java only.

item.name: Dropped Item
item.note: Any item lying on the ground. /kill @e[type=item] cleans them all up.

ominous_item_spawner.note: Drops items during an ominous trial.

area_effect_cloud.name: Potion Cloud
area_effect_cloud.note: The cloud left by a lingering potion or dragon's breath.

evoker_fangs.note: The biting fangs an evoker summons. Called evocation_fang on Bedrock.

elder_guardian_ghost.name: Elder Guardian Ghost
elder_guardian_ghost.note: The spooky elder guardian face that flashes on your screen. Bedrock only.

marker.note: An invisible point that map makers use to remember a spot. Java only.

interaction.note: An invisible box that notices when you click or hit it. For map makers. Java only.

block_display.note: Shows a block floating in the air, at any size. For map makers. Java only.

item_display.note: Shows an item floating in the air. For map makers. Java only.

text_display.note: Shows text floating in the air. For map makers. Java only.

npc.name: NPC
npc.note: A character that can talk and run commands, for map makers. Bedrock only.
